note: Shows choosing melodies by filter: each melody-singer names a difficulty and a stage with pick instead of a tune number, the second a step harder than the first. The text describes the kind of tune, then walks the app: hear it, start the mic, watch the staff.

exercise.title: Two tunes: steps, then skips
exercise.focus: An easy Do Re Mi tune, then a medium Do Mi Sol tune, in G
exercise.why: Tunes that move by step are the easiest to sing in tune, so they come before tunes that skip.

sections.text: A tune on Do, Re and Mi. Press Play to hear it. Then start the mic to sing it: your pitch shows on the staff as you go. Once it feels easy, try singing it before you hear it.
A longer tune that skips through Do, Mi and Sol. Look at the staff first. Guess how it goes. Press Play to check your guess, then sing it with the mic.
